pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: `empty` is interpolated raw into the template. It is safe today because the only dynamic part is escaped, but the template now trusts its caller to pre-escape.
findings.fix: Pass a flag or the raw query and build the message inside the template.
